idea-plugin.name: Colibri Code
idea-plugin.description:
Adds Colibri Code to JetBrains Air as an installed agent card, backed by a model running on this machine.

The plugin installs a managed ACP bridge, publishes Colibri through Air's agent registry, and registers its local launch command in Air's installed overlay. The card can be enabled, disabled and removed from Air's Agents page like any other agent. The engine starts on the first prompt, not when Air opens, and stops after it has been idle, so an open IDE costs no model memory. An engine that was already running is attached to and left alone.
